title: Compactly generated exact localization source for a Grothendieck derived category
statement: Let A : Type uA be an abelian category with morphism universe vA, Grothendieck relative to w, with a chosen w-Hom derived category D(A) and coproducts indexed by Type max(w,vA,vH). There exists a category B with objects in Type max(uA,vA,max(w,vH)+1) and morphisms in Type max(w,vH), equipped with a zero object, an additive integer shift, a preadditive triangulated structure, and Type max(w,vH)-indexed coproducts. B is compactly generated [def-pc-compactly-generated]. There exist L : B → D(A), R : D(A) → B and an adjunction L left adjoint to R with invertible counit. L commutes with integer shifts and preserves distinguished triangles. This assertion is independent of any cohomological functor H and does not assert representability.

source.place: Tag 0F5V (injectives-lemma-gabriel-popescu), Tag 0F5X first paragraph; size extension by the free presentation and Baer criterion, Tag 05NU

proof.text: Obtain a common ring S, exact abelian Gabriel–Popescu localization F left adjoint to U with invertible counit, and compactly generated B with exact equivalence e to this same derived module category from the presentation theorem. Install its supplied structures.

Derive U additivity from the abelian adjunction. Apply exact localization to obtain triangulated F.mapDerivedCategory and invertibility of the counit of the specific adjunction to U.rightDerivedFunctor.

Set L=e.functor composed with F.mapDerivedCategory, R=U.rightDerivedFunctor composed with e.inverse, and compose e.toAdjunction with the specific derived adjunction. Shifts and triangulatedness compose. At each X the composite counit is F.mapDerivedCategory.map of the equivalence counit followed by the derived counit; both are invertible. Reassemble the original existential conclusion.
